patch_description: Cross-over hybrid ansatz: combine the best-performing ring and hub entanglements from the two reference implementations. The ring uses parameterized CRX gates around the outer ring (shared parameter crx_ring), while the hub-layer combines CRZ and CRY gates from center to each edge with shared parameters (crz_hub_edge and cry_hub_edge). This preserves parameter sharing for efficiency and adheres to adjacency constraints. All other layers (pre/post RZ and RY with symmetry-based sharing) remain as in the original seeds. The resulting ANSATZ_SPEC is richer than the baseline, potentially improving validation accuracy while keeping the same training loop, data, and measurement structure.
